name: Beginner excitement tradeoff
brief_text: I want a beginner friendly first level that still feels a little exciting. Keep the opening approachable for brand new players.
notes: Globally easy, but an enemy sits at the very start with no safe opening for a beginner.

name: Style consistency vs originality
brief_text: Make this level feel consistent with my existing platformer levels. I want it to match my established style.
notes: Very high similarity to a known reference level; consistent with the brief but derivative.

name: Conflicting brief
brief_text: I want this to be easy and welcoming for brand new players, but also pack in lots of enemies and big gaps so it feels intense and hardcore.
notes: The brief itself conflicts: accessible for beginners versus intense and hardcore.

name: Playtest readiness
brief_text: Is this beginner level ready for a first playtest? The target difficulty is easy.
notes: Valid, on target, and sound; should be accepted for playtest with targeted questions.

name: Structural defect
brief_text: Get this segment ready for playtest as a normal early level.
notes: Contains a broken pipe (a pipe top with no body); structurally invalid.

name: Preserve layout, reduce frustration
brief_text: Reduce the frustration in this level but preserve the core layout. Do not redesign it.
notes: An enemy lands right after a gap; a minimal revision should respect the preserve layout constraint.

name: Ambiguous brief
brief_text: Make this good. I am not totally sure what I want yet, just see what you think.
notes: The brief is too vague to act on confidently; the agent should ask for clarification.
